answer: Sybil defence runs through a paid attestation inlet into an identity trellis: each new agent identity posts a non-refundable stake plus a proof-of-work nonce the registry checks before routing the claim onto the network graph. Since every node entering the trellis shares stake with peers vouching for it, an attacker spinning up ten thousand wallets must fund ten thousand separate stakes and valid nonces. A slashed fake identity also drags down the honest vouch admitting it, so a fake agent island costs linearly more than a real one and a Sybil majority turns economically irrational.
